data.body: **[P2] Publish revocation immediately after receiving the response.** A queued operation can start after `checkpoint()` returns but before `handleMissingToken()` sets `checkpointTokenRevoked`, observe `false`, execute user side effects, and then fail to checkpoint—causing duplicate execution on replay. Read the response token into a local and, for a nonterminal tokenless response, publish the revocation flag before logging or exposing the null token. Add a latch-based test for this worker-start window.
